Acrylic light guides

By Sam Example

Cast acrylic (PMMA) carries light by total internal reflection, so a sheet lit from one edge glows at the far edge. See the physics or our fiber guide.

Why the edges glow

Scratches and engraved lines break the reflection and let light out, which is why etched signs light up.

  • Polished edges: bright line of light
  • Frosted edges: soft glow
    • Sanded at 400 grit
    • Flame polished
  1. Cut the sheet
  2. Polish the edge
